declienting: BEM range-field__* classes replaced with library semantic utilities (text-text-primary, text-text-secondary, bg-border-subtle, bg-action-base, outline-border-focus)
data-module="range-field" DOM-scan auto-init replaced with a React controlled/uncontrolled value API (value / defaultValue / onChange)
hidden form-output input removed; the selected option's value is emitted through onChange and consumers own their own form wiring
per-mark data-value/data-label/data-description attributes removed; the scale is a typed options prop instead of being read back off the DOM
--range-field-progress custom property replaced with a React-owned inline progress width, scoped to the painted track
server-supplied max attribute removed; max is derived from options.length and the index is clamped against it
